notes: SEQN is the unique respondent identifier. It maps to person_source_value to link all records to the same individual.

Dietary day one sample weight is a survey design weight. It can be stored as an Observation with a custom concept for the weight type, or in a custom table. No standard OMOP concept exists for NHANES dietary weights.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a survey design weight. Similar to WTDRD1, stored as an Observation with a custom concept.
Food/Individual component number is an ordinal identifier for food items within a recall. Maps to value_as_number in Observation, with a custom concept for the variable.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating completeness/reliability. Requires a custom concept; no standard OMOP concept exists.
Interviewer ID code is an identifier for the interviewer. Stored as a string in Observation, as it does not fit standard provider tables without additional context.
Breast-fed infant indicator. Could map to concept_id 40762366 (Breastfeeding) or similar, but exact mapping depends on value encoding. Stored as Observation.
Number of days of intake is a categorical variable (e.g., 1 or 2 days). Requires a custom concept; no standard OMOP concept.
Number of days between intake and household interview is a continuous variable. Stored as value_as_number in Observation.
Intake day of the week. Could potentially map to standard day-of-week concepts, but typically stored as a custom concept in Observation.
Language respondent used mostly. Could map to ISO language concepts if available, otherwise custom concept.
Combination food number is an ordinal identifier. Stored as value_as_number in Observation.
Combination food type is a categorical/text description. Stored as value_as_string in Observation.
Time of eating occasion (HH:MM). Can be stored as a time or datetime in Observation. Requires a custom concept for 'eating occasion time'.
Name of eating occasion (e.g., breakfast, lunch). Could map to meal type concepts if available, otherwise custom concept.

Source of food is a categorical variable describing where food was obtained. It can be mapped to observation with a custom concept for the source category, or stored as value_as_string if no standard concept exists.
Binary indicator for whether meal was eaten at home. Could use standard Yes/No concepts (e.g., 4188539 'Yes', 4188540 'No') or a custom concept.
USDA food code is an identifier for the food item. It can be stored as a string in observation or mapped to a standard food concept if available in the vocabulary.
Grams of food consumed. Map to measurement with a concept for food weight (e.g., 0 for 'Gram' unit). Unit concept_id would be 8587 'gram'.
Energy in kcal. Standard concept for 'Energy' (kcal) is 4267697. Unit concept_id for kilocalorie is 9557.
Protein in grams. Standard concept for 'Protein intake' is 3025315. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Carbohydrate in grams. Standard concept for 'Carbohydrate intake' is 3025315 (or more specific child concept). Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Total sugars in grams. Could map to a standard concept for sugar intake if available, or use a custom measurement concept. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Dietary fiber in grams. Map to a standard concept for fiber intake if available. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Total fat in grams. Standard concept for 'Total fat intake' is 3025315 (or child concept). Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Saturated fatty acids in grams. Map to a standard concept for saturated fat intake if available. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Monounsaturated fatty acids in grams. Map to a standard concept if available. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Polyunsaturated fatty acids in grams. Map to a standard concept if available. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Cholesterol in mg. Standard concept for 'Cholesterol intake' is 3025315 (or child concept). Unit concept_id for milligram is 9655.
Vitamin E as alpha-tocopherol in mg. Map to a standard concept for vitamin E intake if available. Unit concept_id for milligram is 9655.
Added alpha-tocopherol (Vitamin E) intake in mg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept ID for Vitamin E.
Retinol intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept ID for Retinol.
Vitamin A, RAE intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept ID for Vitamin A.
Alpha-carotene intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept ID for Alpha-carotene.
Beta-carotene intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept ID for Beta-carotene.
Beta-cryptoxanthin intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept ID for Beta-cryptoxanthin.
Lycopene intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept ID for Lycopene.
Lutein + zeaxanthin intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept ID for Lutein and Zeaxanthin.
Thiamin (Vitamin B1) intake in mg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept ID for Thiamin.
Riboflavin (Vitamin B2) intake in mg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept ID for Riboflavin.
Niacin intake in mg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept ID for Niacin.
Vitamin B6 intake in mg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept ID for Vitamin B6.
Total folate intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept ID for Folate.
Folic acid intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept ID for Folate (folic acid is a form of folate).
Food folate intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept ID for Folate.
Folate, DFE (mcg) maps to measurement of folate intake. Concept 3007220 is 'Folate, dietary folate equivalents'.
Total choline (mg) maps to measurement of choline intake. Concept 3018621 is 'Choline, total'.
Vitamin B12 (mcg) maps to measurement of vitamin B12 intake. Concept 3005456 is 'Vitamin B12'.
Added vitamin B12 (mcg) is a specific sub-component of total B12. No standard concept exists for 'added' B12; map to measurement with null concept_id or use a custom concept.
Vitamin C (mg) maps to measurement of vitamin C intake. Concept 3000713 is 'Vitamin C'.
Vitamin D (D2 + D3) (mcg) maps to measurement of total vitamin D intake. Concept 3004409 is 'Vitamin D'.
Vitamin K (mcg) maps to measurement of vitamin K intake. Concept 3004737 is 'Vitamin K'.
Calcium (mg) maps to measurement of calcium intake. Concept 3001222 is 'Calcium'.
Phosphorus (mg) maps to measurement of phosphorus intake. Concept 3006923 is 'Phosphorus'.
Magnesium (mg) maps to measurement of magnesium intake. Concept 3006377 is 'Magnesium'.
Iron (mg) maps to measurement of iron intake. Concept 3004470 is 'Iron'.
Zinc (mg) maps to measurement of zinc intake. Concept 3009131 is 'Zinc'.
Copper (mg) maps to measurement of copper intake. Concept 3001816 is 'Copper'.
Sodium (mg) maps to measurement of sodium intake. Concept 3008102 is 'Sodium'.
Potassium (mg) maps to measurement of potassium intake. Concept 3007277 is 'Potassium'.
Selenium intake from Day 1 dietary recall. Maps to 'Selenium, dietary [Mass]' concept.
Caffeine intake from Day 1 dietary recall. Maps to 'Caffeine [Mass]' concept.
Theobromine intake from Day 1 dietary recall. No standard OMOP concept exists; map to measurement table with value_as_number.
Alcohol intake from Day 1 dietary recall. Maps to 'Alcohol intake in grams per day' concept.
Moisture (water) intake from Day 1 dietary recall. No standard OMOP concept; map to measurement table with value_as_number.
Saturated fatty acid 4:0 intake. No standard OMOP concept for individual fatty acid intake; map to measurement table with value_as_number.
Saturated fatty acid 6:0 intake. No standard OMOP concept; map to measurement table with value_as_number.
Saturated fatty acid 8:0 intake. No standard OMOP concept; map to measurement table with value_as_number.
Saturated fatty acid 10:0 intake. No standard OMOP concept; map to measurement table with value_as_number.
Saturated fatty acid 12:0 intake. No standard OMOP concept; map to measurement table with value_as_number.
Saturated fatty acid 14:0 intake. No standard OMOP concept; map to measurement table with value_as_number.
Saturated fatty acid 16:0 intake. No standard OMOP concept; map to measurement table with value_as_number.
Saturated fatty acid 18:0 intake. No standard OMOP concept; map to measurement table with value_as_number.
Monounsaturated fatty acid 16:1 intake. No standard OMOP concept; map to measurement table with value_as_number.
Monounsaturated fatty acid 18:1 intake. No standard OMOP concept; map to measurement table with value_as_number.

Maps to measurement table as a nutrient intake value. The specific fatty acid (Eicosenoic acid) would be captured in measurement_concept_id, but no standard OMOP concept exists for this specific nutrient; value_as_number holds the gram amount.
Maps to measurement table as a nutrient intake value. Docosenoic acid intake in grams; measurement_concept_id would need a custom or non-standard concept.
Maps to measurement table as a nutrient intake value. Octadecadienoic acid (linoleic acid) intake in grams; no direct standard concept_id available.
Maps to measurement table as a nutrient intake value. Octadecatrienoic acid (alpha-linolenic acid) intake in grams; no direct standard concept_id available.
Maps to measurement table as a nutrient intake value. Octadecatetraenoic acid intake in grams; no direct standard concept_id available.
Maps to measurement table as a nutrient intake value. Eicosatetraenoic acid (arachidonic acid) intake in grams; no direct standard concept_id available.
Maps to measurement table as a nutrient intake value. Eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) intake in grams; no direct standard concept_id available.
Maps to measurement table as a nutrient intake value. Docosapentaenoic acid (DPA) intake in grams; no direct standard concept_id available.
Maps to measurement table as a nutrient intake value. Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) intake in grams; no direct standard concept_id available.
